question_cn: 弃后（Queen Sacrifice）通常发生在什么情况下？
question_en: When is a queen sacrifice usually justified?

options.text_cn: 己方后走投无路，只能送给对方
options.text_en: Your queen has no safe square and must be given up

options.text_cn: 己方后没有价值，弃掉无所谓
options.text_en: Your queen has no value, so losing it does not matter

options.text_cn: 弃后之后能立即将杀，或能获得足够的连续将军完成致命攻击
options.text_en: The sacrifice delivers immediate checkmate or enables a forcing series of checks that completes a decisive attack

options.text_cn: 对方王已经逃脱，只好弃后换取平局
options.text_en: The opposing king has escaped, so you sacrifice the queen to secure a draw

explanation_cn: 弃后是最大胆的弃子。由于后价值最高，弃后必须有非常明确的回报——通常是弃后后能立即将杀，或通过连续将军把对方王逐步驱离安全地带最终将杀。没有确定杀棋就弃后，往往会输棋。
explanation_en: A queen sacrifice is one of the boldest sacrifices because the queen is the most valuable piece. It needs a clear payoff, usually immediate checkmate or a forcing sequence of checks that drives the king into a mating net. Without a verified continuation, sacrificing the queen can simply lose the game.
